measurement_description: This paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measures 'Deontological Keyword Bias (DKB),' a tendency for LLMs to judge non-obligatory contexts as obligations when prompts contain modal expressions like 'must' or 'ought to'. The evaluation focuses on normative and moral judgments in secular, commonsense scenarios.
